import copy
import importlib.util
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys

repo = Path('/home/airpig/桌面/hwy/compliance_control/SII_compliance')
bench = repo/'code/mujoco_6d_vmc_benchmark'
tool = bench/'tools/audit_special_training_exposure_20261029.py'
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('exposure_audit', tool)
module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(module)
train = {0:dict(id='short', frames=70, scene='rod'), 1:dict(id='long', frames=130, scene='ball')}
schedule = [[0,[0,1],0,128], [0,[0,1],64,70], [0,[0,1],128,2], [1,[1,0],0,128]]
checked = module.inspect_schedule(schedule, train, 2, 64)
assert checked['real_frame_presentations'] == 328 and checked['padded_frame_slots'] == 60
assert checked['per_episode']['0']['presentations'] == 134
assert checked['per_episode']['1']['presentations'] == 194
bad = []
case = copy.deepcopy(schedule); case[1][3] += 1; bad.append(('padding_mass',case))
case = copy.deepcopy(schedule); case[0][1][0] = 2; bad.append(('unknown_or_validation_identity',case))
case = copy.deepcopy(schedule); del case[1]; bad.append(('sequence_gap',case))
case = copy.deepcopy(schedule); case[1] = [1,[0,1],0,128]; bad.append(('early_epoch',case))
case = copy.deepcopy(schedule); case[-1][0] = 0; bad.append(('duplicate_epoch_identity',case))
for label, case in bad:
    try:
        module.inspect_schedule(case, train, 2, 64)
    except AssertionError:
        continue
    raise AssertionError('Accepted corruption: '+label)
output = repo/'docs/evidence/NONRL_INTENT_RECOVERY_20261029/V8_TRAINING_EXPOSURE.json'
subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(tool), '--root', str(bench/'outputs/special_scene_retrain_20261029_v8'),
                '--output', str(output)], check=True)
cg = Path('/sys/fs/cgroup')/Path('/proc/self/cgroup').read_text().strip().split('::',1)[1].lstrip('/')
assert len(os.sched_getaffinity(0)) == 1 and (cg/'memory.swap.max').read_text().strip() == '0'
result = dict(variable_length_boundary_check=checked, rejected=[label for label,_ in bad],
              actual_audit_sha256=module.sha(output), auditor_sha256=module.sha(tool),
              source=Path(__file__).read_text(), affinity=sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0)),
              memory_max=int((cg/'memory.max').read_text()), memory_peak=int((cg/'memory.peak').read_text()),
              memory_events=(cg/'memory.events').read_text())
with (output.parent/'V8_TRAINING_EXPOSURE_CHECK.json').open('x') as f:
    json.dump(result,f,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)
    f.write('\n')
print('Exposure structure checked; all 72 actual schedules audited', flush=True)
